title: PinnacleAFK
description: PinnacleAFK lets players use /afk to show they are away, freeze in place, and gain damage protection after a short delay.
body: **PinnacleAFK** is a simple AFK protection plugin that lets players use `/afk` to mark themselves as away, freeze in place, display AFK in the tab menu and above their name, notify the server, and gain damage protection after a configurable delay.
